author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
I tried. It doesn't work. I am Mike and I literally clone myself into AI. People still just email me or message me instead of using my chatbot.
Having AI replies my emails and messages for me make it worse, they start asking me questions that I don't know and assume I would know. Because I am very good at using AI, I end up searching the answers of those new questions for them.

reshared_post.author_headline: Co-Founder @ byteLAKE | Solving Operational Problems with AI | Explainable AI, Industrial AI & AI Agents for Business
reshared_post.reshared_text:
Boring AI: Stop asking Mike
Mike has been with the company for 22 years.
Mike knows which manual matters.
Mike remembers the weird failure from 2018.
Mike knows which supplier specification changed.
Mike knows why the official procedure isn't quite how things work in reality.
Everyone asks Mike.
That's wonderful.
Until Mike is in another plant.
Or on vacation.
Or retires.
Imagine combining documentation, maintenance history, internal knowledge and operating information so other people can access more of what the organization already knows.
That's one of the practical roles we see for AI Agents.
Boring AI doesn't replace Mike.
It lets Mike stop answering the same question 14 times.
